# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We are committed to providing a welcoming, inclusive, and harassment-free environment for everyone participating in Corex Code, regardless of experience level, identity, background, or personal characteristics.

## Standards and Expectations

Participants are expected to:
- Demonstrate empathy and respect toward other contributors and users.
- Provide constructive, thoughtful feedback focused on technical merit and code safety.
- Gracefully accept constructive criticism.
- Prioritize user safety, code clarity, and architectural integrity.

Unacceptable behavior includes:
- Harassment, derogatory comments, or personal attacks.
- Trolling, insulting remarks, or disruptive conduct.
- Publishing private information without explicit consent.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing standards of acceptable behavior and will take appropriate action in response to any violations.
